open.notes: Sheets, numbers, text, booleans, formulas (shared strings and inline strings).

edit.notes: Formula engine: arithmetic, comparison, &, ranges, cross-sheet refs, SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTA, IF, AND, OR, NOT, ROUND, ABS, CONCAT, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, LEN, UPPER, LOWER.

save.notes: Cached results written; fullCalcOnLoad set so spreadsheet apps recalculate.

knownLosses: Cell formatting, number formats, column widths, merged cells, conditional formatting, data validation
Charts, images, tables, pivot tables, named ranges, hyperlinks, comments
Functions outside the list above evaluate to #NAME? in HyperSheet (formula text is kept)
Not validated against Microsoft Excel (L5 requires an REA investigation)
